name: Uncertainty Propagation for Iso-Surface Extraction
definition: A method for efficient iso-surface extraction from Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) by propagating uncertainty through the network to estimate the output distribution, allowing for hierarchical extraction that skips inactive cells.
summary: Uncertainty Propagation is a hierarchical iso-surface extraction method for Implicit Neural Representations that uses propagated Gaussian uncertainty to predict active cells, skipping inactive nodes to reduce computation time.
